name: travel_agency
description: Next.js + TypeScript demo travel site — Terraform on DigitalOcean, Docker, nginx blue/green deploys and GitHub Actions

paragraphs: Next.js website I originally built for a real travel agency and ran in production. After the client closed, I turned it into a fictional portfolio demo ("Mochila") and rebuilt its whole delivery pipeline: infrastructure as code, signed container images, zero-downtime blue/green deploys, one-click rollbacks and monitoring.
Demo only: the agency is fictional, no bookings are made and the contact form sends nothing.
